title: Deployment
summary: Publish the project and learn hosting basics, Git, and production workflows.
content:
# Deployment: Shipping Your Portfolio

Deployment is the final step where your project becomes publicly available. A clean deployment helps you share your work and verify that the site behaves the same in production.

## What To Prepare

### Production Build
Make sure your app can be built and served reliably without local development tools.

### Hosting Options
Common choices include:
- GitHub Pages
- Netlify
- Vercel
- A Docker-based host

### Final Checks
- Verify links, images, and forms
- Confirm the site works on mobile and desktop
- Update your README with clear setup and deployment steps

## Your Task
Prepare the portfolio for deployment and publish it using a static host or container workflow.
